en.gameDesc: The Pigeonhole Principle states: if n items are placed into m containers with n > m, then at least one container must hold more than one item. Apply this to solve guaranteed-outcome problems!

af.gameDesc: Die Duiwegat-beginsel sê: as n items in m houers geplaas word met n > m, dan moet ten minste een houer meer as een item hou. Pas dit toe om gewaarborgde-uitkomsprobleme op te los!

zu.gameDesc: Umthetho Wesikhundla Sejuba uthi: uma izinto ezingu-n zifakwa ezitsheni ezingu-m lapho n > m, okungenani isitsha esisodwa kufanele sibe nezinto ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Sebenzisa lokhu ukuxazulula izinkinga zemiphumela eqinisekisiwe!
